name: Compact Makeup Brush Cleaner Plate
description:
The Compact Makeup Brush Cleaner Plate is a practical and efficient tool designed to deep-clean your brushes with ease. Its textured surface effectively lifts stubborn makeup residue, oils, and impurities from bristles while remaining gentle enough to prevent damage. Built from highly durable materials for long-lasting use, its compact, travel-friendly design makes it a perfect addition to any makeup kit or bathroom vanity.

This item is available in three vibrant colors: white, yellow, and pink.
